description: The file defines the EventMigrationStatus class, which tracks the status of event migrations, including counts of processed, migrated, skipped, and error events, as well as detailed records of each migration step.

classes.name: EventMigrationStatus
classes.description: A class for maintaining and representing the status of event migration operations, including counters and detailed records.

methods.name: incrementProcessed
methods.description: Increments the count of processed events.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Adds a migration detail record and updates counters based on its type.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation summarizing the migration status and details.
